entries.definition: acceptable for a long time, or having a long history
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling of *time-honored*, carrying the same dignity conferred by long standing.

entries.definition: receiving deferential regard
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain-spoken, understated form of *respected*: the same deference, named without ceremony.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most forgiving word here - the missing care reads as freedom from burden rather than neglect of duty.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Bravado rather than lightness - it flaunts the disregard where *carefree* simply has no worry to shed.

entries.definition: characterized by inability or unwillingness to work toward a goal or assume responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flatly dismissive - it writes someone off by what they never get done, with no charm allowed into the failing.

entries.definition: not fit to assume responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A verdict of unfitness rather than a report of behaviour, and the most withering word in the set.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Motion with the brakes off - it approves the ease while leaving the absent check audible.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Indulgent - it credits a temperament rather than charging a fault.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Its jingling repetition makes the cheer sound scatterbrained, tipping into scolding where *happy-go-lucky* stays fond.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A light word for the fault - what is missing is restraint, not any active wrongdoing.

entries.definition: showing lack of care for consequences
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain charge the rest take their colour from - blame falls on the consequences left unweighed, with none of the cheer of *carefree*.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of restraint or responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a moral edge *idle* does not - the restraint gone slack is the kind a person is expected to hold.

entries.definition: cheerfully irresponsible
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The cheer here undercuts the person as giddy and unfit to be trusted, where *carefree* leaves them intact.

entries.definition: irresponsible in the use of firearms
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The cheerful *-happy* ending set against carelessness with a gun is the whole sting of it.

entries.definition: free from control or responsibility
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Positional rather than evaluative - it states the absence of anyone to answer to, without judging the person for it.

entries.definition: lacking a sense of responsibility
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Judged from outside - where *irresponsible* looks at the consequences, this looks at whoever was depending.

entries.definition: highly skilled
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise with attainment behind it — skill brought to a high finish, warmer and more admiring than the flat *skilled*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for deft, unlaboured sureness — it admires the aptitude in the doing where *expert* admires the knowing.

entries.definition: highly skilled
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves by totality rather than dazzle — it says nothing is missing from the skill, a cooler verdict than *accomplished*.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative praise — skill carried to its finish with nothing left to add, far above the workaday *proficient*.

entries.definition: marked by great skill especially in meticulous technique
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for fineness of touch — skill admired for precision and restraint rather than the power heard in *masterful*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The authoritative member: it grants knowledge that can be leaned on and vouched for, weightier and less warm than *good*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The mildest approval here — it concedes competence and stops, where *expert* confers standing.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise that hears authority in the skill — command of the craft, where *accomplished* only reports a high finish.

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Admires mastery in the execution rather than in the person, the quieter of the pair beside *masterful*.
examples: a masterly performance of the sonata

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits skill that has been worked in until it is habitual, steadier and less brilliant than *virtuoso*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measured, almost certifying approval — it reports that the standard is met, with none of the admiration in *masterful*.

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the approving weight of *skillful* for deftness in execution.

entries.definition: having or showing or requiring special skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plain, checkable praise — it credits capability without admiring it, and can sit on the work that demands the skill as easily as on the person who has it.
examples: only the most skilled gymnasts make an Olympic team
a skilled surgeon has many years of training and experience
a skilled reconstruction of her damaged elbow

entries.definition: having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves the handling itself — visible dexterity in execution, more concrete than the standing implied by *expert*.
examples: a lesser-known but no less skillful composer
the effect was achieved by skillful retouching

entries.definition: having or revealing supreme mastery or skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise pitched at display — mastery brilliant enough to be watched, showier than the sober *consummate*.

entries.definition: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The sophistication is charged to surfeit, which sours the praise - it marks a person as past being impressed where *worldly* only marks them as experienced.
examples: the blase traveler refers to the ocean he has crossed as ‘the pond’

entries.definition: possessing sound knowledge
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The approval is for sound knowledge itself, with none of the social finish *sophisticated* insists on.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for the finish, where the assurance is the visible surface and *refined* names the quality under it.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Names the refinement itself rather than its display, so it praises without the suggestion of buffing that *polished* carries.

entries.definition: having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises worldly knowledge and refinement together, and it settles on the thing made for such a person as easily as on the person - a reach *urbane* lacks.

entries.definition: showing a high degree of refinement and the assurance that comes from wide social experience
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The formal member, putting the weight on assured ease of manner rather than the surface shine *polished* names.
examples: maintained an urbane tone in his letters

entries.definition: possessing sound knowledge
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Flatter than *intelligent* - the credit goes to what a person knows, not to anything in the knower.

entries.definition: experienced in and wise to the ways of the world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises shrewdness rather than polish - it says a person cannot be fooled, which *urbane* never claims.

entries.definition: very sophisticated especially because of surfeit; versed in the ways of the world
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Takes the versed-in-the-ways-of-the-world half of the sense straight, crediting the experience without the taint of excess *blase* carries.
examples: the benefits of his worldly wisdom

entries.definition: tried unsuccessfully
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks the act as the thing that failed rather than the one who made it, which is where it parts from *defeated*.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Failure recast as a loss to something stronger, carrying the sting of being beaten that *unsuccessful* leaves out.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The softest of the blocked set - the failure sits in a hope let down rather than in any force that stopped it, unlike *thwarted*.

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal, and it adds embarrassment to the failure: not merely beaten but put out of countenance.

entries.definition: doomed to extinction
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and final, a verdict pronounced with none of the room for recovery that *frustrated* still leaves open.

entries.definition: lacking resources (or any prospect of resources)
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Widens the failure to a whole condition, nothing held and nothing coming, with a bleakness *empty-handed* keeps at arm's length.

entries.definition: having acquired or gained nothing
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Concrete where *unrewarded* is abstract - it shows the nothing instead of naming it.
examples: they returned from the negotiations empty-handed

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sounds the note of a scheme blocked at the last moment, lighter and more gleeful than the grim *thwarted*.
examples: their foiled attempt to capture Calais

entries.definition: disappointingly unsuccessful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the weight on effort spent for nothing, so the failure feels drawn out rather than delivered in one blow like *defeated*.
examples: many frustrated poets end as pipe-smoking teachers
